patch.summary: Closely implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Closely by mapping current sales-intelligence workflows to Closely objects, confirming plan gates for built-in calling (Growth, Essential, Custom), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: built-in calling (Growth, Essential, Custom)
Integrate after: data quality pass on Salesforce

blocks.heading: Closely day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Closely setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves B2B outbound teams automating LinkedIn + email before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Salesforce and HubSpot before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover built-in calling (Growth, Essential, Custom)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record.
Do not expand seats until prospecting is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Not a CRM deal-pipeline system of record.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Plans are gated by LinkedIn sender seats and enrichment/AI credit bundles.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Bonus enrichment/AI credits emphasized on Growth/Essential versus Starter.

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: LinkedIn automation carries platform-policy/compliance risk inherent to the category (operational, not a feature checklist item).

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Closely plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Starter
lines.description: Trial available · Unlocks: prospecting, data enrichment, email sequences · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.title: Validate sales-intelligence fit before a deep Closely rollout
blocks.body: If Closely fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Closely object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
If blocked, evaluate Amplemarket before sunk-cost expansion
